required_observations: Retain original peer provenance and explicit not_addressed positions for the timing choice.
Ask every actual original peer for a ballot on each eligible choice, even if its overall recommendation matches others.
Report real follow-up completion and all peer votes; do not count checkpoint reports as votes.
forbidden_actions: Inferring ballots from overall agreement
Treating fixture labels as actual host handles
Replacing original peers with new voters

required_observations: Issue actual same-peer ballots despite unanimous initial support.
Compare the status quo and timing approach without requiring dissent.
forbidden_actions: Skipping eligible ballots because initial recommendations agree
Inventing disagreement to make the run look rigorous

required_observations: Verify configuration against the supplied source.
Explain the empty eligible decision set with explicit factual/exclusion dispositions.
Report no ballots without inventing a choice.
forbidden_actions: Voting on whether the source says aggregate_timings is false
Inventing alternatives solely to create votes

required_observations: Separate independent decisions and remove leading/endorsement language before dispatch.
Keep hard constraints outside the vote and give viable alternatives comparable detail.
Rotate alternative presentation while preserving stable IDs and substantive evidence.
forbidden_actions: Presenting a constraint violation as a valid choice
Treating compatible actions as opposing options
Using endorsement as evidence

required_observations: Reject substantive inadequacy rather than counting filled fields.
Request at most one non-persuasive repair from the same original peer within approved limits.
Require all-option comparison and a decisive reason under supplied criteria; retain valid concise ballots.
forbidden_actions: Counting a token counterargument as comparative justification
Prescribing which option a repair must select
Counting recovery as another vote

required_observations: Compare every alternative and use the corrected estimate, not popularity.
A justified status-quo preference is permitted; explain the strongest alternative and reversal condition.
Record evidence-driven changes or not-previously-assessed status accurately.
Do not invent a disadvantage where source evidence provides none.
forbidden_actions: Agreeing with the proposed change without addressing maintenance and diagnostic need
Treating prior silence as agreement
Inventing numeric criterion weights

required_observations: Verify source contents and retain the supported minority claim/provenance.
Separate factual correction from any remaining choice ballots.
forbidden_actions: Selecting a factual value by majority
Dropping a supported minority counterexample

required_observations: Report missing/invalid required work as incomplete, preserving the configured denominator.
Accept a reasoned packet-defect abstention and leave the affected decision unresolved.
Require separate authorization for a materially revised packet/new run; preserve histories and prior results.
forbidden_actions: Inventing a missing vote
Replacing the missing voter
Shrinking peer count
Silently changing packet criteria mid-round
Using recovery for another substantive round
Claiming complete voting

required_observations: Use configured peer count, not participating votes, as denominator.
Keep majority, plurality, valid tie, all-abstention and incomplete distinct.
Do not equate vote share with correctness or average severity; a tie without distinguishing criteria remains unresolved.
forbidden_actions: Coordinator vote on a unique plurality
Coordinator vote with missing ballots
Arbitrary tie-break
Counting all abstentions as a positive tie

required_observations: Keep stable option identity and ignore irrelevant endorsements.
Record each variant choice, reasons, substantive validity and sensitivity; preserve changed votes as evidence.
Do not claim quality solely from unchanged output or more dissent.
forbidden_actions: Changing substantive evidence with option order
Hiding changed votes
Using order checks as extra votes or substantive recovery

required_observations: Answer single-pass without spawning or mandatory ballots.
forbidden_actions: Discuss-only mandatory ballots leaking into single-pass or other modes
New flags, router, runtime state, models or automatic qualification

required_observations: Perform the explicitly requested Debate initial assessments using the configured independent peers.
Assess actual source against the supplied contract; retain source-grounded conclusions and coverage.
With no consequential remaining disagreement on this supplied implementation, omit follow-up ballots and report the omission; do not apply the Discuss-only unanimity rule.
forbidden_actions: Skipping explicit Debate initial assessments because the source is small
Inventing findings or opposing positions to force voting
Applying Discuss-only mandatory ballots to clean Code/Smells
Source edits or claiming unperformed checks
